recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it is a narrow source correction that preserves the approved default behavior while removing an internal contradiction in the current HTTP history section.
issue_request: FHIR-31709 was a Published FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to introduce _sort for history interactions with accepted values _sort=_lastUpdated, _sort=-_lastUpdated as the default, and _sort=none.
initial_application: Git commit 639dbcd2848776be444488fe66b23438c581256d added the _sort row and allowed values to source/http.html. The older lead sentence still said history Bundles were sorted with oldest versions last, which made the accepted alternate sort values appear contradictory.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread explains that newest-to-oldest was the existing behavior and that synchronization needed a forward traversal option. FHIR-I minutes on 2021-08-09 confirm the accepted Option 2 _sort syntax and 16-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote. source/http.html is linked from source/documentation.html as the RESTful API page and is the active source for the HTTP history guidance.
reconciliation: Updated source/http.html to say history Bundles include deleted resources, are sorted with oldest versions last by default, and can have that order adjusted using the _sort parameter described below. The existing _sort table was left intact.
source_changes: source/http.html: clarified the introductory history Bundle ordering sentence to make oldest-last the default and reference the _sort parameter for alternate ordering.
